newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Reaal and SNS plan insurance/banking merger.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Reaal and SNS plan insurance/banking merger.

text.p: Unlisted Dutch insurer Reaal Groep NV and unlisted Dutch bank SNS Groep NV said on Thursday they were exploring the possibility of a complete merger.
If the merger goes ahead it would create a Dutch financial group with total assets of almost 40 billion guilders ($23.8 billion).
The two companies said the merger study would focus on the joint development of the "all-finance" and "multi-channel" concepts for financial services.
"Reaal and SNS complement each other in the field of product range, know-how, labels, distribution channels and structure of total income," they said in a joint statement.
Because of this, a merger was not expected to lead to job cuts, they added.
